observations.polystyrene30: Baseline phenyl rings visibly crowd into a fused-looking ladder on part of the backbone. Fixed drawing shows separated phenyl rings on alternating sides of an open horizontal backbone.
observations.polystyrene75: At whole-drawing Fit the baseline has a long narrow ladder-like crowded region; fixed drawing has two separated alternating ring rows. Fine bond and ring details are small at15–16%.
observations.polystyrene100: Baseline has a long narrow ladder-like region; fixed drawing has separated alternating ring rows across a horizontal backbone. Fine details are small at11–12%.
observations.alanine200: Baseline native Fit shows a compact dense cluster with extensively superposed chemical labels. Fixed whole chain spans a long horizontal line at4%; individual labels are too small to judge from this capture.
observations.stereo-alanine200: Baseline native Fit shows the same dense cluster with visibly crowded labels and wedges. Fixed whole chain spans a long horizontal line at4%; individual wedges/labels and200-center retention cannot be established visually at this scale.
